children: Spot trading for the NEXO token begins on Kraken on October 22, 2026. Kraken Listings announced the listing, which makes NEXO available for spot purchases and sales on the exchange.

The listing widens NEXO's market reach by adding access through a major global exchange. Kraken's support for fiat pairs also connects the token to an exchange where users can trade with traditional currencies.
